Building a Quiet Workshop

REQUIRED-BLOG-ONE: Start by listing the operations that create impact noise, airborne noise, or vibration.

  • REQUIRED-BLOG-LIST: Separate machines from shared walls.
  • Seal gaps around doors before adding expensive panels.
  • Measure again after every change.
REQUIRED-BLOG-QUOTE: Quiet design is mostly careful control of paths.

REQUIRED-BLOG-END: The result should be easier to work in, not merely impressive on a specification sheet.
